questionsAsked:
1) Declare a variable in C++ / size of int (bytes).

2) How to take input & print output (a+b) in C++?

3) Difference between float and double.

4) Meaning of signed/unsigned.

5) Product of 3 integers with constraint 10^6 (with test cases incl. negative numbers)
 
6) Sum of alphabet positions of 2 lowercase letters
 
7) Output of int a=true; int b=false; cout<<a-b
 
8) Factorial of n (constraint n≤20)
remarks:
1) Candidate knows int vs. long long distinction and true/false as 1/0, but struggles with implementation.

2) Got stuck explaining range/constraint handling.

3) Weak on char/ASCII usage.
performedWell:
1) Correct I/O syntax (cin>>a>>b; cout<<a+b).

2) Understood float vs. double distinction.

3) Identified need for long long for product exceeding int range.

4) Correctly reasoned boolean subtraction (1-1=0)
improvementAreas: 1) Practice implementation problems across all Level-0 topics, focusing on data types, char/ASCII, and if-else.
